scope: Complete visual refresh of all 14 active O Fim boss images: the original manifestation, return skill, and three fear forms.
lore: O Fim is the King of Hell and an eternal principle that sleeps rather than dies. He has no fixed true body or face; each observer sees their own greatest fear. All depicted bodies are subjective manifestations, not canonical anatomy.
style: Hybrid hand-painted 2D/3D animation: visible brush planes, broken ink contours, angular graphic shadows and restrained hatching; candid action, varied camera angles, correct anatomy, no posed skill art.
approvedDirection: The user rejected the intermediate military-general Tyrant. The approved Tyrant direction is the first grotesque infernal monster: colossal and asymmetrical, flames consuming the skin, irregular horns, black facial void and an exclusive asymmetric ivory/brass diadem; two arms and two legs clearly articulated. No uniform, mantle, staff, bridges, tribunal, or giant-fist silhouette.

identity.original: Slender spectral sovereign in a dissolving dark mantle, empty face, two tarnished-gold orbit rings and sparse ivory roots.
identity.tyrant: Colossal grotesque infernal humanoid; asymmetrical charred skin consumed by flames; irregular horn-prongs on the exclusive ivory/brass diadem; exactly two arms and two legs.
identity.predator: Lean four-legged hunter with ring-shaped void head and broken ivory crescents.
identity.ruin: Floating broken basalt arch with fragmented torso and exactly four spectral arms; no legs or crown.
